verdict.rationale: Aider documents editing files, auto-committing changes, running tests, and one-shot scripted runs via --message. There is no documented way to ingest a tracked issue or to open a pull request. Commits, raw /git commands, and community users wiring Aider into their own PR pipelines are adjacent building blocks or user-side workarounds, not an end-to-end issue-to-PR capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end
